meta.name: CCNL Servizi di Pulizia e Servizi Integrati/Multiservizi (ANIP-Confindustria)

family.reason: Cleaning and integrated services companies (ANIP multiservizi).

notes.text: Salary model: SPLIT. The tabellare is a time series; contingenza and EDR are frozen fixed_allowances. Tranches of July 2021 to July 2024: art. 73 tables of the renewal of 8 June 2021 (CNEL 139292, pp. 32-34, signed by ANIP). From July 2025: the ANIP-signed fifth tranche of CNEL 139292 p. 34. Later unsigned tables of 6 August 2025 (CNEL 234752) are excluded (see anip_unsigned_renewal). No table prints the tabellare of 2par115 and 4par125 after April 2013: it is the April 2013 amount (CNEL 105782 pp. 30-31) plus the parametric increments.
hourly_divisor 173: 'Ai fini della determinazione della retribuzione oraria, il divisore mensile è 173' (art. 19, CNEL 105782 p. 40).

additional_months 14: tredicesima by 20 December (art. 20) and quattordicesima by 15 July (art. 21), each one retribuzione globale mensile (CNEL 105782 p. 41). The quattordicesima accrues from 1 July to 30 June.

Seniority, impiegati: biennial scatti of 6.25% of the tabellare in force when each scatto matures plus the contingenza at 1/8/1983 (EUR 279.60), at most 8 and up to 50% of tabellare + 279.60 (art. 22, CNEL 105782 p. 41). A matured scatto keeps its amount: it is not recomputed at later tranches. The file holds one series per level (2021-2024 computed on the CNEL 139292 tables) and the engine prices every matured scatto at the run date; it pays scatti to levels 5, 6, 7 and Q, while the CCNL pays them to the impiegati of levels 2-7 and Q. Declared in multiservizi_seniority_maturation.

Seniority, operai: anzianità forfettaria di settore, one fixed monthly amount not paid for the first four years of sector seniority (art. 22, CNEL 105782 pp. 41-42; amounts in the table of p. 90). Modelled with first_cadence_months_by_level 48 and maximum_count_by_level 1 for levels 1 to 4; the CCNL also pays it to the operai of levels 5 and 6 (66.77, 82.99). Declared in multiservizi_seniority_maturation.

Contingenza of 2par115 and 4par125: no text prints one. The notes a verbale of art. 10 (CNEL 105782 p. 30) classify these workers at level 2 with parameter 115 and at level IV with parameter 125, so the file applies the contingenza of levels 2 and 4.

Apprenticeship: two levels below the destination for the first half and one below for the second, destination II at level I throughout (art. 12, CNEL 105782 p. 37; the parametric positions are skipped). Durations come from the accord of 19 July 2012, read only in a third-party copy of the 2021 text: II 24, III 30, IV 30, V 36, VI 36, VII 36 months. The file models destinations 4 and 5 with 30 months each: destination 5 should last 36 and the other destinations are missing. The 2012 duration schedule has not been verified on the signed cached PDFs; declared in multiservizi_apprenticeship_destinations.

July 2025 values: the renewal of 8 June 2021 (CNEL 139292, signed by ANIP) sets a fifth tranche from 1 July 2025 (level 2 +10.00, tabellare 779.21, p. 34), provisional under the art. 73 consuntivo. The renewal of 13 June 2025 (CNEL 234754) and its tables of 6 August 2025 (CNEL 234752) raise level 2 to 819.21 from the same date, but ANIP signed neither. The file applies the ANIP-signed 2021 fifth tranche from July 2025 and excludes the later unsigned tranches (see anip_unsigned_renewal). No ANIP amount for the art. 73 consuntivo or the IPCA increments of art. 73-bis and 73-ter was found.

ANIP CONTRACT STATUS (2025): the renewal of 13 June 2025 (CNEL 234754) and its tables of 6 August 2025 (CNEL 234752) are signed by AGCI Servizi, Confcooperative Lavoro e Servizi, Legacoop Produzione e Servizi and Unionservizi Confapi with Filcams-CGIL, Fisascat-CISL and Uiltrasporti-UIL; ANIP-Confindustria signed neither. ANIP companies keep the renewal of 8 June 2021 (this file). A separate file would cover the 2025-2028 renewal (levels 1-7 and Q, retribuzione base 1,296.39 to 2,256.14 EUR from May 2026, 14 mensilità).

INPS: terziario regime. Cleaning contractors are CIGS employers above 15 employees: D.Lgs. 148/2015 art. 20 c. 1 d) ('imprese appaltatrici di servizi di pulizia, anche se costituite in forma di cooperativa, che subiscano una riduzione di attività') and, from 1 January 2022, art. 20 c. 3-bis and art. 23 c. 1-bis ('a carico dei datori di lavoro che, nel semestre precedente la data di presentazione della domanda, abbiano occupato mediamente più di quindici dipendenti [...] è stabilito un contributo ordinario nella misura dello 0,90 per cento'). contribution/2026/terziario.json already charges the CIGS 0.90% (0.30% on the worker, INPS circ. 117/2022 all. 1) above 15 employees and the FIS of art. 29 below.
Workers covered: no sourced figure. The earlier note (~403,000, INPS-UNIEMENS 2025) and meta.workers_estimate (~580k) disagree and neither cites a document.

LATER UNSIGNED TRANCHES: the May 2026 and later minima of the renewal of 13 June 2025 (CNEL K511, deposits 234754 and 234752) were not signed by ANIP and are excluded. The signed July 2025 fifth tranche of the 2021 renewal (CNEL 139292 p. 34) is applied; no subsequent ANIP minimum or actual IPCA adjustment has been verified.

limitation.remediation: Source an ANIP-signed later minimum or verified IPCA adjustment before adding subsequent tranches.

notes.text: SENIORITY (CNEL 105782 art. 22, pp. 41-42, 90): Levels 2-6 include both operai and impiegati. The single level-based schedule assigns the wrong form of seniority to some workers: impiegati receive eight biennial scatti at most, operai one sector amount after four years (including levels 5 and 6). Scatti must retain their value at maturation and after promotion, with a ceiling of 50% of tabellare plus EUR 279.60; the existing schedule reprices every matured scatto at the current rate. Sector seniority survives contract changes within the sector.

limitation.remediation: Route scatti and forfettaria by worker category, preserve each matured amount across tranches and promotion, respect the ceiling and sector service history.

notes.text: SICKNESS (CNEL 139292 art. 51, pp. 22-24): operai receive a top-up to 100% of net global pay on days 1-180, then 50% of gross global pay on days 181-270. Impiegati receive 100% of stipendio plus contingenza for five months and 50% for seven; both are subject to a twelve-month comporto in a rolling 36-month window. The existing rule ends pay at day 180, uses gross throughout and does not route by category; the rolling comporto alone is represented.

limitation.remediation: Apply separate category rules and day-dependent net/gross bases to operai; apply the separate stipendio-plus-contingenza impiegati bands.

notes.text: OVERTIME AND NIGHT WORK (CNEL 105782 art. 38, p. 57): ordinary overtime hours use global pay, whereas percentage supplements use base pay (tabellare and contingenza). Holiday work attracts 50%; ordinary night work attracts 20% in rotating shifts or 30% otherwise. The four overtime bands, the ordinary holiday band and the two night bands use the printed rates, with a separate tabellare-plus-contingenza premium base. The engine cannot automatically enforce the non-cumulation of simultaneous holiday and night premiums or the incidence of continuous night supplements on deferred pay.

limitation.remediation: Do not stack simultaneous holiday and night premiums; account for continuous night premiums in deferred pay where applicable.

notes.text: PART-TIME SUPPLEMENTS (CNEL 139292 art. 33): supplementary hours and elastic clauses have distinct rates and eligibility. OT_SUPPLEMENTARE covers additional hours at ordinary global hourly pay plus 28% of tabellare and contingenza. The engine does not defer the 28% to the following month or include its incidence in indirect and deferred pay including TFR; it does not route the distinct elastic-clause hours, enforce part-time eligibility or the full-time ceiling.

limitation.remediation: Route elastic clauses separately (10% on global pay for shifted hours, plus 1.5% for additional hours); enforce part-time eligibility and the full-time ceiling, next-month settlement and incidence on deferred pay including TFR.

notes.text: VARIABLE ALLOWANCES (CNEL 105782 art. 24): hardship, cash-handling and collection duties require separate daily, hourly or percentage bases and qualifying work events. The retained personal EDAR is absorbed at the next qualifying seniority increment (art. 22 pp. 41-42). No amounts for work not evidenced by the source are inferred.

limitation.remediation: Model each evidenced allowance on its own qualifying duty and base; track the individual EDAR and absorption at the first subsequent increment.

notes.text: COMPLEMENTARY PENSION (CNEL 105782 art. 54, pp. 69-70): The frozen 1 January 2001 tabellare and contingenza bases, 1% employer and member shares and twelve monthly payments are modelled for enrolled workers. Fund eligibility still depends on the employer association (Previambiente for FISE, Fondapi for CONFAPI, Cooperlavoro for cooperatives, with a choice for non-affiliated employers); fixed-term membership requires six months of work within the calendar year. These eligibility facts are not established by the enrolment alone. ASIM and ONBSI are addressed by the separate health_and_bilateral_funds limitation.

limitation.remediation: Verify the employer association and accumulated calendar-year fixed-term work before accepting the caller-selected fund and enrolment. No eligibility is inferred from the level or the fund code.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP (19 July 2012 accord): destination 5 is configured for 30 months rather than 36; destinations 2, 3, 6 and 7 are not configured. The cited duration schedule has not been verified on the cached signed 2011 or 2021 PDF and must not be inferred from a third-party copy.

limitation.remediation: Obtain and verify the signed 2012 apprenticeship accord before changing durations or adding destinations.

notes.text: LEAVE (artt. 19, 41, 42 of the 2011 text): 22 days of ferie on five days, 26 on six (Employment.full_time_week_days), in twelfths with the month over 15 days; 40 hours a year of reduced time (art. 42). At termination a day of ferie is the monthly pay over 22 (26 on six days), an hour of permits over 173. The ex festività are compensatory permits for the abolished holidays worked (art. 41): not a bank, not accrued. The 2025 renewal (72 hours of permits according to the union summary) is not read in a primary text.

SIGNATORIES: ANIP is not among the original signatories of the 13 June 2025 renewal and the 6 August 2025 tables (CNEL 234754, 234752); a later ANIP accession or a separate ANIP agreement was not found but is not excluded. From July 2025 the file applies the ANIP-signed fifth tranche of the 8 June 2021 renewal (CNEL 139292 p. 34); with an accession the 2025 renewal minima (level 2 819.21 from July 2025) would apply instead.

limitation.remediation: Source an ANIP accession or an ANIP-signed later agreement before adding later minima.

notes.text: IPCA CONSUNTIVO: CNEL 139292 p. 34 makes the July 2025 table provisional, subject to the 2021-2024 IPCA consuntivo of June 2025 (and pp. 35-36 provide the 2025-2026 IPCA mechanism). No consuntivo adjustment has been found, so the printed provisional amounts are paid from July 2025.

limitation.remediation: Source the IPCA consuntivo of June 2025 and any later IPCA adjustment for ANIP and adjust the July 2025 minima.
